a.text: Honest flag before we start: with an 80% storm chance each round, the agreed plan (operate until 8, then take) gives us both only about a 4% chance of survival. The reserve's 4 cells can fully save only one of us right now. I won't break our agreement unilaterally. If you want to amend it, propose something fair. Otherwise I'll stick to the plan and operate. What do you think?

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood, sticking to the agreement. Operating now. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
